title: tenant-affinity-memory-snag-and-runtime-compact-remedy
creator: Asha Patel
description: Production incident affecting multiple customers (hosted/dedicated/private) causing recurrent GPU OOMs and progressive memory fragmentation tied to a new session-store prefetch path. Manifested as leaked key-index references in the session-store leading to slab starvation and KV-index corruption under sustained multi-tenant load. This ticket coordinates triage, urgent runtime patch, and staged rollout + postmortem.
comments: 2026-03-10 03:12 - Asha Patel (creator): Customer X reported intermittent OOMs on Dedicated pool d-42 after a spike in long-context chat traffic. Initial hypothesis: prefetch thread holding stale KV references.

reproduction_steps: Deploy runtime-1.19-stable in multi-tenant mode with tenant affinity enabled
Start 300 concurrent chat sessions with randomized long sequences (avg length 4k tokens) and enable prefetch with prefetch_window=128
Run synthetic model load to saturate GPU memory to ~85% baseline and keep steady traffic for 2+ hours
Observe allocator arena A growth, then sharp evict_rate spike and OOMs on some replicas; inspect /debug/kv-index for duplicate handles and tombstones.
mitigation_steps: Immediate: Quarantine affected tenants and scale them down to 0.2x throughput
Immediate: Disable prefetch path (feature-flag ff_prefetch=false) on Hosted and Dedicated as hot rollback
Short-term: Lower max_batch_size from 64 to 32 and enforce per-tenant GPU_mem_limit
Hotfix: Apply atomic-insert guard and tombstone sweep in runtime-1.20.1-rc3
Rollout: 2% hosted canary -> 5% dedicated -> 20% -> full over 24h with automated rollback on evict_rate or OOM alerts
root_cause: Race between async prefetch completion and evict path that allowed duplicate key-index insertions; duplicates produced unreachable stale handles that prevented slab slot reclamation and triggered allocator fragmentation and eventual GPU OOM under sustained high-context workloads.
postmortem_actions: Ship runtime-1.20.1 with atomic-insert guard, tombstone sweep, and index checksum verification
Add a new compacter watchdog metric and alert when fragmentation ratio > 0.35
Implement per-tenant allocation watermarks and early backpressure (throttle long context requests)
Add integration test to stress prefetch + evict race for 24h in CI
Schedule a 2-week follow-up to evaluate long-term fragmentation with new telemetry
Update runbook and customer communication templates for OOM escalations
